name: tool-strip
title: Tool strip
description: Verbs over a selection, adapted to it: verbsFor(selection, sets) keeps the verbs every selected kind shares; Surface(graphite-strip) as a plate whose ends travel when the verbs change, Button(strip) caps with glyphs and Tooltip names, the rest in a More key, and the destructive verb as Button(strip-danger) after a Rule. Places itself over the selection's bounds and rises 4 on the part spring.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/tool-strip.md. SwiftUI: MetalToolStrip in the MetalUI Swift package.
